description: A utility class for changing font styles and sizes of Swing JComponent objects, specifically providing methods to set fonts to plain or bold styles with optional size adjustments.

classes.name: SetFont
classes.description: Utility class offering static methods to modify the font style and size for Swing components.

methods.name: plain
methods.description: Sets the font of a JComponent to plain style with its current font size.

methods.name: plain
methods.description: Sets the font of a JComponent to plain style with a specified size.

methods.name: bold
methods.description: Sets the font of a JComponent to bold style with its current font size.

methods.name: bold
methods.description: Sets the font of a JComponent to bold style with a specified size.
